issues.description: The UML and problem description specify addGuestStudents(int) as returning void, but the solution implementation declares addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This creates a method return-type mismatch that can confuse students about the intended signature and expected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's addGuestStudents method match the specification: change its signature to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) and update its implementation to throw or handle invalid input according to the exercise's guidance; OR update the problem statement/UML to indicate a boolean return and document the meaning (e.g., true on success, false on invalid input) so all artifacts agree.
